title: capability_denied
description: The agent refused a request because a capability or a server module is off on this device, or because the device is not enrolled. The server writes an audit event, raises a notification and forwards it to the panels. With `task_id` the task becomes `Denied`; with `transfer_id` (capability `files`) the file transfer becomes `rejected` and the device's file capability is stored as off. Agents send the same capability/action/reason at most once a minute, except when `task_id` is set.

capability.description: terminal, vision, patches, wol, files or exam (Windows agent).

action.description: What was refused: a server action (execute, start_vision_session, start_stream, wake_peer, scan_updates, install_updates, file_push, file_pull, exam_mode), a remote_input sub-command (get_thumbnail, set_fps, remote_input) or vision_tunnel (the tray asked for the Vision channel).

transfer_id.description: Only for a refused `file_push` or `file_pull`: the transfer from that message.

reason.description: 0.1.12+. Missing = local capability policy; "module_disabled" = the server module is off for the device's lab; "not_enrolled" = no device secret, so the Vision channel was not opened.
